comment: What the cutover moves, in order. One entry per app; more in apps.d/*.json (one file per product line). Fields: README.md, 'The app list'.

apps.name: site
apps.comment: The catalogue: today the monorepo-projects-site Worker; on AWS the site stack's CloudFront distribution (stacks/site). Static, so no freeze and no data.

apps.name: grants-redirect
apps.comment: Today the grant-autopilot Worker's custom domain answers 301 to /grants/; the site stack's CloudFront alias and host redirect replace it. Grant Autopilot itself moves with the paid apps (apps.d).
